name: CyberKongz
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: The official Twitter account of CyberKongz in the NFT project was attacked by hackers, who replaced the homepage links, etc. with phishing links and released false Mint information. At present, the account has been renamed and is under freezing protection.
